subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat long-press scope be limited to Copy and Select Copy, or should it also include Share and Reply, and should maintainers adopt the conflicting fork PR or request a narrower target-repo PR?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the capability is still missing, but the requested action set changes Android chat UX beyond a strict bug fix and the only open linked implementation is conflicting.

options.title: Approve narrow copy/select-copy first
options.body: Request or sponsor a target-repo PR that adds message copy and selective copy, with Share and Reply deferred unless separately approved.

options.title: Adopt the full action sheet
options.body: Have an Android owner reconcile the fork PR's Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply design if maintainers want that broader chat action surface now.

options.title: Decline the extra actions
options.body: Keep only the existing code-block selection behavior and close or redirect the broader action-menu request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow copy/select-copy first
recommendation.body: Request or sponsor a target-repo PR that adds message copy and selective copy, with Share and Reply deferred unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android chat merger and adjacent `ChatMarkdown` fix merger, with the best available routing signal for an Android UX scope decision.
